SELECT current_reading FROM smt_ele_meter_history WHERE is_delete = 0 AND ele_meter_id = #{meterId}
AND collect_time >= to_date( #{firstDay}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' )
AND to_date( #{lastDay}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' ) >= collect_time
order by collect_time desc

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, ELE_METER_ID, COLLECT_TIME, CURRENT_READING, IS_ERROR FROM SMT_ELE_METER_HISTORY WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND IS_ERROR = 0 AND ELE_METER_ID = #{meterId} AND (COLLECT_TIME < #{collectTime} OR (COLLECT_TIME = #{collectTime} AND ID < #{historyId})) ORDER BY COLLECT_TIME DESC, ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT ID FROM SMT_ELE_METER WHERE ID = #{meterId} FOR UPDATE
